name: How should a homeowner prepare before kitchen finish carpentry begins?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare before kitchen finish carpentry begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your kitchen for finish carpentry, clear the work zone completely of personal items, small appliances, and existing pantry goods. Ensure that flooring is either completed and adequately protected or prepped according to the installation sequence. Homeowners should also finalize cabinet hardware, light fixture placements, and appliance dimensions, as trim carpenters need exact appliance clearances to set filler strips, decorative panels, and refrigerator surrounds correctly. Having all trim profiles and cabinet delivery packages on-site before work begins prevents mid-project delays and allows the crew to inspect materials for warping or transit damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all cabinets and countertops, verify exact appliance dimensions for clearance planning, and have all millwork and cabinet orders delivered and inspected on-site.
